brand.name: Rebild
brand.logo_instructions: Custom UI component: 'Re' in orange (~#F77418), 'bild.' in white, the dot in orange. Use strong typography (e.g. Outfit or Clash Display) for the logo mark. DO NOT use placeholder images.

rules.headings: Tracking-tight, Outfit, bold or black weights for extreme impact.
rules.body: Clean, highly readable Plus Jakarta Sans.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Duotone L-Shape App Shell. Dark sidebar and topbar (#0A0A0A) form an L-shape wrapper. The main content area sits inside it as a massive white (#FFFFFF) block with a rounded-tl-3xl border-radius on desktop, creating an 'app within an app' high-end feel.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Generous padding inside the white content area (p-6 to p-12).
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboard stats (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Exposed grid borders in data-heavy areas. Light borders (border-border/40) inside the white content area.

surface_strategies.sidebar: Solid Obsidian Black (#0A0A0A), completely flat, with high-contrast active states.
surface_strategies.topbar: Solid Obsidian Black (#0A0A0A), flat, houses notifications and profile.
surface_strategies.content_area: Solid White (#FFFFFF), subtle shadow-sm, rounded-tl-3xl (on md+ screens), acting as a nested container for tables, stats, and settings.
surface_strategies.cards_inside_content: Flat white background, 1px subtle border (#E4E4E7), no default shadow. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surface_strategies.login_screen: Dark Mode full-bleed background (using login_bg image) with glassmorphism card (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, 1px border-white/20) for the login form.

components_and_interactions.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary buttons are #F77418 with white text. Hover states explicitly define background and text color.
components_and_interactions.tables: Dense, crisp data tables in the light content area. Use exposed grid lines (border-b) but keep headers clean. Left-align data.
components_and_interactions.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs, adapted to the light surface (white bg, gray border) with orange focus rings (focus:ring-[#F77418]).
components_and_interactions.navigation: Active states in sidebar should use a subtle #F77418 left border and text color change.
components_and_interactions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

icons_and_assets.imagery_rules: No placeholder images. Use provided URLs only.

image_urls.description: High-end abstract 3D geometric waves in deep matte black and bright electric orange. Use as full-bleed background for the Login Screen.
Luxury dark mode abstract texture. Use for admin panel empty states or hero headers in dark mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use only valid Javascript React files (.jsx or .js), avoid Typescript unless the environment is already setup for TS.

Build the Shell structure first: A full-height flex or grid layout where the Sidebar and Topbar are dark (#0A0A0A background, text-white), and the <main> content area is nested within it, featuring bg-white, text-zinc-950, and rounded-tl-3xl on desktop.
Implement the Rebild logo textually or via SVG exactly as requested: 'Re' in #F77418, 'bild.' in white, with an orange dot.
Ensure the login page uses the 'login_bg' image full screen with a centered glassmorphism card for the login form.
Use shadcn components heavily for the table (Invoices, Clients), Inputs (Login, Profile), styling them appropriately for the crisp white surface they sit on.

Admin and Client portals should have distinct sidebar navigation links (Admin: Dashboard, Clients, Services, Invoices, Add-ons, Tickets, Settings. Client: Dashboard, Services, Add-ons, Invoices, Updates, Reports, Support, Profile), but share the same layout architecture.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Ensure mobile responsiveness. On mobile, the sidebar becomes a hamburger menu in the topbar, and the rounded-tl-3xl content area becomes square to fit the screen edges.
